convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh include (coensiotrader1v06.mqh) for chart drawing/utility functions, multi-timeframe logic (H4 MAs inside H1/D1 strategy), wininet.dll for HTTP calls, and complex optimization data mining logic that is MT5-platform-specific

derived_values.name: Pip value (digit-adjusted)
derived_values.used_by: SL/TP calculation, slippage, lot sizing, trailing stop

derived_values.name: MarketDirection
derived_values.used_by: Displayed on chart, computed only for chart symbol

long.right: Higher low (Mrate[1].low > Mrate[2].low) AND Lower low prev (Mrate[2].low < Mrate[3].low) AND DEMA uptrend (DemaVal[0]>DemaVal[1]>DemaVal[2])

short.right: Lower high (Mrate[1].high < Mrate[2].high) AND Higher high prev (Mrate[2].high > Mrate[3].high) AND DEMA downtrend (DemaVal[0]<DemaVal[1]<DemaVal[2])

params.note: StopLossPips1 default=100; varies per currency pair (100-200)
TakeProfitPips1 default=250; varies per currency pair (100-300)
Trails when distance from price exceeds (StopLoss+TrailingStep)*Pip, then moves SL by TrailingStep*Pip

other_exits: Equity take profit: closes ALL positions when AccountEquity > AccountBalance * EquityTakeProfit (default 1.2)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If RiskMax>0: risk-based sizing = ((RiskMax/100)*FreeMargin / StopLossPips) / (Pip/Point); If RiskMax==0 AND LotSize>0: fixed lots = LotSize; If RiskMax==0 AND LotSize==0: deposit fraction = Equity / LotBalanceDivider (default 1000000). Clamped to MODE_MINLOT and MODE_MAXLOT, normalized to 2 decimals.

custom_logic_notes: 1) BarLogic() creates new indicator handles EVERY bar (iBands, iDEMA, iMA) — resource leak, handles are never released. 2) H4 SMA 21/50/100 are copied but never used in entry/exit decisions — possibly vestigial or for future use. 3) MarketDirection is only set when symbol==Symbol() (chart symbol only), but entry signals use DEMA trend independently for each currency pair. 4) CheckOpenOrders() uses PositionSelect(symbol) which only checks by symbol name, not iterating all positions — may miss positions in multi-currency mode. 5) OpenSell returns false on success (bug — returns false at line 498 instead of true). 6) EA phones home to coensio.com for version verification and optimization result uploads via wininet.dll. 7) Supports up to 6 currency pairs simultaneously with separate indicator params per pair.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Indicator handle leak in BarLogic() must be restructured — create handles once in __init__, use CopyBuffer on each bar. 2) Multi-currency support needs proper position tracking per symbol (not just PositionSelect by symbol). 3) H4 SMAs are computed but unused — can be omitted unless intended for future logic. 4) Timer-based event model (OnTimer at 60s intervals) must be replicated with scheduled checks. 5) DEMA is a built-in MT5 indicator but must be manually implemented in Python (EMA of EMA). 6) Bollinger Band entry logic uses bar[1] vs bar[2] vs bar[3] comparison — ensure shifted bar access is correct. 7) Digit-adjustment logic (Pip calculation) must be handled per symbol. 8) wininet.dll HTTP calls for EA verification and optimization upload are platform-specific and should be removed or replaced. 9) The OpenSell bug (returning false on success) should be fixed in conversion. 10) Trailing stop logic: distance check uses (StopLoss+TrailingStep)*Pip threshold before stepping — this is non-standard trailing, must replicate exactly.
